welcome.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

welcome.title: Welcome to MariPuntos
welcome.description: The points game for couples: earn points for what you do for your partner and spend them asking for what you want.
welcome.detail3: Keep your streak and compete in the duel

actions.title: Earn points with actions
actions.description: An action is something you do for your partner or the home: doing the dishes, a romantic gesture, running an errand.
actions.detail2: Your partner reviews and approves it
actions.detail3: The points are added to your balance

permissions.title: Spend your points on permissions
permissions.description: A night out with friends? A gaming afternoon? Ask for it as a permission and pay with the points you earned.
permissions.detail1: Choose or create the permission you want
permissions.detail2: Send the request to your partner
permissions.detail3: If they accept, the points are deducted

growTogether.title: Grow together
growTogether.description: To play, link your account with your partner's. We'll guide you step by step when you get in.
growTogether.detail2: Duel: compete to score more points
growTogether.detail3: Achievements and levels for your progress

login.title: Welcome back!
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep earning points with your partner

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Join MariPuntos and start earning points with your partner
register.createdMessage: Check your email for the verification code
register.failedMessage: Couldn't create the account. Please try again.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a verification code to
verifyEmail.newCodeTitle: We sent you a new code
verifyEmail.newCodeMessage: The previous code was no longer valid. Check your email.
verifyEmail.resendFailed: Couldn't send a new code. Try "Resend code".

backPrompt.title: Cancel verification
backPrompt.message: Are you sure you want to leave? You'll need to verify your email when you sign in again.

leavePrompt.changeEmailMessage: You'll go back to registration to use a different email address.
leavePrompt.cancelMessage: The current registration will be left incomplete.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot my password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to reset your password

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} and your new password
resetPassword.symbolRule: Must contain at least one symbol (e.g. !@#$)
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been changed successfully
